title: Market drops and account logins
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator behind an attention count.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator behind an attention count affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator behind an attention count in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
